evidence: The ROM stream at 0x00127AEE reaches its command-0 terminator at 0x00127B5F.
The next byte at 0x00127B60 begins a separate blank-frame stream selected by SceneResource_RunBlankStream127B60.
The direct wrapper sources are distinct, so the former 0xE4-byte owner incorrectly included the complete 0x00127B60-0x00127BD1 stream.
conclusion: SCENE_RESOURCE_BLANK_STREAM_STATE_03 owns 0x00127AEE-0x00127B5F only; SCENE_RESOURCE_BLANK_STREAM_127B60 independently owns 0x00127B60-0x00127BD1.
